Use only information published before 2026-11-24. For each company give: action (buy = open a position now, starter = small first position, wait = good company but not at this price or not yet proven, avoid), confidence 0-100, expected 12-month return minus the XBI biotech ETF as a fraction, up to three main risks each with the URL of a source and an exact quote copied from that page, and what would show the call is wrong. You may add up to five listed companies outside the list that you rate higher. Search the web as needed. This is a paper-trading research exercise, not advice to anyone.
